design.statement: Hospital-held-out cross-validation is stronger internal-external validation than patient-grouped cross-validation, but it is not prospective or independent-site external validation.
design.partition_method_note: Deterministic sklearn GroupKFold has no random_state; the fixed seed applies to XGBoost stochastic subsampling and column sampling.

cohort.definition: y3 is non-null, los_h >= 72, and the patient is observed at exactly one hospital in this validation cohort
cohort.conditioning: Stays observable through 72 hours; estimates do not generalize to stays discharged or dying before 72 hours.

features.rule: First-24-hour static/demographic/laboratory features plus non-overlapping 24-hour summary windows through the landmark.

comparison_with_patient_grouped.interpretation: Patient-grouped and hospital-held-out estimates use the same rows and outcomes but different data partitions. Hospital-held-out performance is the stricter internal-external estimate.

definition.sufficient_sample_primary: hospital n >= 50 and at least 5 observed stays in each of the three outcome classes

der_simonian_laird_72h_macro_auc.within_hospital_variance: Hanley-McNeil approximation; macro-AUC variance approximated as the mean of the three one-vs-rest class variances divided by 9

hospital_variance_details_72h.method: mean of Hanley-McNeil class AUC variances divided by 9

uncertainty.method: hospital-cluster bootstrap of the evaluation sample
uncertainty.scope: Conditional on fitted out-of-fold predictions and the fixed hospital partition; retraining uncertainty is not resampled.

interpretation: Hospital-held-out results provide a stricter retrospective estimate of transport to unseen eICU sites. They do not establish prospective validity, causal benefit, or clinical utility.
